newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said lending slowed today with banks and other financial bodies preparing for a new treasury bond issue.
The Ministry of Finance has said it will issue 20 billion yuan of seven-year T-bonds. A public tender will be held shortly for underwriting rights before the issue starts on November 1.
"Trading was dull, with much lower lending," one trader said. "There was a rough balance of supply and demand, with major banks reducing their lending."
Traders expect the rates to move in a narrow range in the short term before the central bank cut bank reserve ratios.
